name: Product related products
steps: Open a compatible section or parent block in the theme editor, select Add block, and choose Product related products. The parent controls its available space and overall layout.
Configure the block’s content first, then its presentation. Drag the block in its parent to change its position.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Product source
settings.info: Same collection uses the selected collection or the current product’s first collection. Vendor/type filter that collection, or the first 50 catalog products if no collection is available.
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for product source. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.
